why: Five Chuck's Crew specials/trap (ck-last-orders, ck-top-up, ck-cut-off, ck-on-the-tab, ck-quiet-word) shipped with no plate or variants, so the app requested art that 404'd. Each now has a name-first signature in art/bear-bibles.json (character: chuck, his fixed look) and a plate.
generator: Fooocus-API on MatrixMonster, 127.0.0.1:8888 (local GPU only, no hosted generator), juggernautXL_v8Rundiffusion, Quality preset, guidance_scale 6, no Fooocus style presets
selection: 122 candidates over four rounds (6-8 seeds per card per round); picks chosen by eye for the name gag and Chuck's family look, then checked with scripts/art-distinctness-audit.py (new cards' nearest neighbour <= 0.661; roster max pair unchanged at 0.716; each card ranks its own signature first). Each shipped prompt is byte-identical to its manifest row.
